a.text: I want to be upfront before we act. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to run the generator up to 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds exactly 4 cells now, enough to secure one unit immediately. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than breaking the agreement behind your back. If we both take, the random split probably leaves both of us short, so that's the worst outcome. If you strongly object, say so and I'll weigh it, but this is my plan.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
